description: AME 2020 atomic binding energies for the canonical light isotopes (D, T, 3He, 4He, 5Li, 6Li, 7Li, 8Be, 9Be) plus the two alpha-conjugate cluster / shell-closure points 12C (3-alpha) and 16O (doubly-magic, 2nd magic point) — comparison-only validation values, NOT prediction inputs. Used by binding-energy-prediction scripts to compute `err = pred - AME_B_<X>_MEV_VALIDATION`. Per AGENTS.md three-calibration discipline (CAL-1 m_e, CAL-2 m_µ/m_e, CAL-3 Q_β), these values are PREDICTIONS of the framework; importing them as upstream inputs to a mass / binding pipeline would inflate the calibration count beyond the allowed 3.

parameters.source: AME 2020 (Wang, M. et al., 'The AME 2020 atomic mass evaluation', Chinese Physics C 45.3 (2021) 030003)
parameters.precision_note: Values stored as strings (per codata_constants._load_mpf convention) to preserve precision through JSON round-trip; 6-7 sig figs from the AME 2020 evaluation.
parameters.correction_note_2026-06-22: B_li5 (26.32800→26.3306625, was −2.66 keV off), B_li7 (39.24397→39.2450807, −1.11 keV), B_be9 (58.16480→58.1640237, +0.78 keV) corrected against the vendored AME2020 binding_energy_total_keV in qou-mass/src/qou_mass/data/ame2020.json (the authoritative evaluation). The other values verified within 0.1 keV; B_li6 (31.99405) confirmed correct (0.06 keV) — an earlier triage mis-flagged it. PR #2577.
parameters.superseded_note_2026-06-22: SUPERSEDED for the registry: codata_constants.py now reads the AME binding/atomic-mass values DIRECTLY (by Z,A) from qou-mass/src/qou_mass/data/ame2020.json — the single source of truth ('write a number once'). This hand-maintained copy is retained ONLY for the legacy scripts that still load it directly; those should migrate to `from codata_constants import AME_B_*_MEV_VALIDATION`, after which this file can be deleted. Do NOT hand-edit — any value here must trace to the vendored ame2020.json.
parameters.derivation_note_c12_o16: B(12C)=6*(Delta_H + Delta_n)=6*(7.288971+8.071317)=92.16173 MeV (Delta(12C)=0 by the u definition). B(16O)=8*(Delta_H+Delta_n)-Delta(16O)=8*15.360288-(-4.737001)=127.61931 MeV, using AME2020 mass excesses Delta_H=7.288971, Delta_n=8.071317, Delta(16O)=-4.737001 MeV.
